question: Who is the author of a travel book ‘From Heaven Lake: Travels Through Sinkiang and Tibet’, which won the Thomas Cook Travel Book Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Seth**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
__ 

• **Vikram Seth** is the author of the travel book titled **"From Heaven Lake: Travels Through Sinkiang and Tibet."** 

• The book is a memoir of Seth’s journey through **Sinkiang (Xinjiang)** and **Tibet**, which he undertook while studying at **Nanjing University in China**. 

• It won the prestigious **Thomas Cook Travel Book Award**, which is awarded to outstanding travel literature. 

• This book provides deep insights into the culture, traditions, and landscapes of the regions Seth traversed, making it a masterpiece in travel writing. 

• Vikram Seth is also well-known for his versatility as a writer, having authored other famous works such as **"A Suitable Boy"** and **"The Golden Gate."** 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 

• **About Vikram Seth:** 
 

• Born on **20 June 1952**, in Kolkata, India, Vikram Seth is one of India's most celebrated writers. 

• He has written novels, poetry, and travelogues that have earned him both national and international acclaim. 

• Seth’s writing style is characterized by its **lyrical prose**, deep characterizations, and vivid descriptions. 
 
 

• **About the Book "From Heaven Lake":** 
 

• The book is based on a journey that Seth undertook in the **1980s** while he was a student in China. 

• It showcases his experiences traveling across **remote landscapes** of **Sinkiang** and **Tibet**, often relying on hitchhiking and local transportation. 

• Seth’s narrative captures the intricate details of the geography, people, and political issues of the regions. 

• The book is highly praised for its blend of **travel writing, cultural observation, and personal reflection.** 
 
 

• **Thomas Cook Travel Book Award:** 
 

• The **Thomas Cook Travel Book Award** was established in **1980** to recognize excellence in travel literature. 

• It was awarded annually until **2004**, when it was discontinued. 

• This award celebrated authors who captured the essence of travel and exploration through their writing. 
 
 

• **Other Works of Vikram Seth:** 
 

• **"A Suitable Boy"**: A widely acclaimed novel known for its detailed portrayal of post-independence India. 

• **"The Golden Gate"**: A novel written in verse, set in the United States, exploring the lives and relationships of young professionals. 

• **"An Equal Music"**: A novel about love and music, revolving around a violinist and his personal journey. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
 

• **Travel Writing as a Genre:** 
 

• Travel writing combines elements of **narrative, observation, and personal reflection** to depict journeys and explorations. 

• It often includes descriptions of **landscapes, cultures, and people**, offering readers a glimpse into unfamiliar places. 

• Renowned travel writers apart from Vikram Seth include **Paul Theroux**, **Bill Bryson**, and **Elizabeth Gilbert.** 
 
 

• **Historical Context of the Book:** 
 

• The journey described in **"From Heaven Lake"** occurred during a period when **China’s socio-political landscape** was undergoing significant changes. 

• The book provides valuable insights into **China’s remote regions**, which were not commonly explored by travelers at the time. 
 
 

• **Significance of the Title:** 
 

• The title **"From Heaven Lake"** refers to a stunning lake in **Sinkiang (Xinjiang)**, symbolizing the beauty and mystique of the region. 

• The title also reflects the spiritual and transformative aspects of Seth's journey.
